messages:
maria: Heads-up: planning a compact base-image rollout on Tue 09:00 PT. Need RBAC tweaks, KMS signing detail, and short vuln triage. Who can own signing and audit handoff?

oliver: I can take RBAC. Quick q: do we grant cosign push to build-runner or only registry-deployer + signer-sa?

sandeep: Keep it minimal: signer-sa for cosign sign, registry-deployer for push. Build runners get only storage.write to build-artifacts, no signer perms.

sec-bot: Ticket created INFSEC-488, audit stream -> infra-audit/logs. Retention 30d for cutover window.

emma: KMS note: prefer KMS-backed signing key (sign-only) vs envelope. If sign-only, need grant cloudkms.signer to signer-sa and rotation window doc. HSM not yet in staging.

maria: Agreed sign-only. We'll use cosign with KMS URI: `kms://projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/releases/cryptoKeys/cutover-key`. Only signer-sa gets sign permission.

oliver: I'll open iam PR and add reviewers. Also will add short runbook steps for rollback.

sandeep: Found CVE-2026-5678 in curl in current base. We'll rebuild with patched curl and run canary plus syscall probes. If any unexpected CAP_NET_RAW or setuid appears, abort.

devops: Preflight job created: build-4512. Steps: slim build -> sign -> push staging -> attest -> smoke tests. cosign command used: `cosign sign --key "kms://projects/redwood/.../cutover-key" <image>`

emma: Can we ensure KMS use is logged with key id and principal? Add alert to sec-pager if key use outside signer-sa.

oliver: PR: iam-configs#501 opened. Roles: signer-sa -> cloudkms.cryptoKeyVersions.signer on key resource; registry-deployer -> storage.objectAdmin on staging bucket; auditors -> logging.viewer. Tagging @maria @sandeep.

maria: Pre-cutover checklist (short): 1) RBAC merged 2) KMS IAM set 3) cosign test pass 4) audit pipeline wired 5) canary green. I'll do go/no-go at 08:30 Tue.

sandeep: I'll run vuln scan and a quick syscall fuzz against canary. If anomalies > threshold, I'll signal abort.

sec-bot: Policy enforcement: `deny-privileged-containers` active on target clusters. Exceptions via INFSEC-489.

maria: Fine. I'll merge RBAC at 17:30 today unless blockers. @oliver include rollback snippet in PR with commands.

oliver: Added runbook snippet to PR:
```
rollback:
1) set deployment image back to old-image:sha
2) run orchestrator rollback
3) revoke new tags if needed
4) notify #incidents and engage sec oncall
```

maria: Thanks all. Ping this thread immediately if preflight fails or we need emergency freeze.
